acceptance: With the option set on a DataFrame platform and DuckDB 2.x, the sketch operations in the write-primitives workload run and report their real status; without it they report SKIPPED with the reason. Or: the write-primitives README states the 1.x-only limitation for DataFrame platforms and this item records why forwarding was not built.
A test covers the chosen behaviour.
context: 2026-11-12 18:25: PR #4175 merged to develop as 6ab8a3d979 (DuckDB bound <3.0.0, lock on 2.0.0). The precondition for this item now holds.
description:
Gap. On DuckDB 2.x the datasketches extension installs only from a third-party repository, and BenchBox requires `--platform-option allow_third_party_extensions=true`, registered for the `duckdb` and `ducklake` platforms (PR #4175). The DataFrame SQL-parity workload in `benchbox/core/write_primitives/benchmark.py` (`_execute_dataframe_sql_parity_workload`) runs sketch operations on an internal DuckDB adapter, but DataFrame platforms do not register the option, so on 2.x those operations are always skipped. The skip message says so accurately; the capability is simply missing.

Expected: either DataFrame platforms that run this workload accept the same option and forward it to the internal adapter, or the documentation states that sketch operations in DataFrame write-primitives runs need DuckDB 1.x.

Guardrails: the default stays off; no third-party repository is contacted without the explicit option. Adapter SDK imports stay lazy.
